title: The Ministry of Apostles

questions.question: This is how one should regard us, as servants of Christ and stewards of the ____ of God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:1 (ESV): "This is how one should regard us, as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God."

questions.question: Moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:2 (ESV): "Moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful."

questions.question: Paul writes, "But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you or by any human court. In fact, I do not even judge ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:3 (ESV): "But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you or by any human court. In fact, I do not even judge myself."

questions.question: Paul says he is not aware of anything against himself, but he is not thereby acquitted. It is the ____ who judges him.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:4 (ESV): "For I am not aware of anything against myself, but I am not thereby acquitted. It is the Lord who judges me."

questions.question: Therefore do not pronounce judgment before the time, before the Lord comes, who will bring to light the things now hidden in darkness and will disclose the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:5 (ESV): "Therefore do not pronounce judgment before the time, before the Lord comes, who will bring to light the things now hidden in darkness and will disclose the purposes of the heart. Then each one will receive his commendation from God."

questions.question: Paul applied these things to himself and Apollos for the Corinthians' benefit, that they may learn the saying: "Not beyond what is ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:6 (ESV): "I have applied all these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, brothers, that you may learn by us not to go beyond what is written, that none of you may be puffed up in favor of one against another."

questions.question: For who sees anything different in you? What do you have that you did not ____?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:7 (ESV): "For who sees anything different in you? What do you have that you did not receive? If then you received it, why do you boast as if you did not receive it?"

questions.question: Paul uses sarcasm writing, "Already you have all you want! Already you have become rich! Without us you have become ____!"
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:8 (ESV): "Already you have all you want! Already you have become rich! Without us you have become kings! And would that you did reign, so that we might share the rule with you!"

questions.question: For I think that God has exhibited us apostles as last of all, like men sentenced to death, because we have become a ____ to the world, to angels, and to men.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:9 (ESV): "For I think that God has exhibited us apostles as last of all, like men sentenced to death, because we have become a spectacle to the world, to angels, and to men."

questions.question: We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You are held in honor, but we in ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:10 (ESV): "We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You are held in honor, but we in disrepute."

questions.question: Paul describes his sufferings: "When reviled, we bless; when persecuted, we endure; when slandered, we entreat." We have become, and are still, like the ____ of the world.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:12-13 (ESV): "When reviled, we bless; when persecuted, we endure; when slandered, we entreat. We have become, and are still, like the scum of the world, the refuse of all things."

questions.question: Paul does not write these things to make them ashamed, but to admonish them as his beloved ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:14 (ESV): "I do not write these things to make you ashamed, but to admonish you as my beloved children."

questions.question: For though you have countless guides in Christ, you do not have many fathers. For I became your father in Christ Jesus through the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:15 (ESV): "For though you have countless guides in Christ, you do not have many fathers. For I became your father in Christ Jesus through the gospel."

questions.question: Therefore Paul urges them to be imitators of him. To remind them of his ways in Christ, he sent whom to them?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:17 (ESV): "That is why I sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, to remind you of my ways in Christ, as I teach them everywhere in every church."

questions.question: For the kingdom of God does not consist in talk but in ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 4:20 (ESV): "For the kingdom of God does not consist in talk but in power."

key_verse_text: For the kingdom of God does not consist in talk but in power.
